批評 hihyou

An alternative GitHub code review experience — a browser extension that takes over the PR "changes" view in place and rebuilds it around actually applying the review.

  • Viewer takeover

    Renders every file's diff itself from GitHub's own route payload; the PR header and tabs stay native, and a floating 批評 pill toggles back at any time.

  • Hunk-level seen state

    Drag across lines and press s: seen hunks anchor as content hashes and dim. A later commit touching the range invalidates them automatically.

  • Apply hunks locally

    a applies the selection as a git diff to your local checkout — entirely in the browser via the File System Access API, verified against the file first.

  • AST core

    web-tree-sitter in the background worker: scope snapping, sticky scope headers, import folding, structural diff, and moved-code detection that inherits seen state.

  • Commit timeline + stacked PRs

    A commit strip with prev/next navigation; stacked PRs flatten into one sequence, and commit navigation morphs code with shiki-magic-move.

  • Twoslash TS hover

    Quick-info popovers typed against the exact dependency versions in the repo's pnpm-lock at the reviewed commit, with .d.ts pulled from npm tarballs.

  • Rich markdown diff

    .md files render as prose with word-level ins/del tracked changes; toggle back to the source diff per file.

  • Inline review threads

    Existing line-anchored comment threads render under their lines, resolved ones collapsed.

Try the viewer

The real @hihyou/diff-viewer over a captured payload (wxt-dev/wxt#2464). Click the tree, fold files, drag-select lines and press s to mark them applied.
